label: Boat-shaped 3.0 cm
description: At 3.0 cm the boat-shaped breast pocket reaches a generous, full-bodied dimension that transforms it into one of the most visually commanding details on the jacket's front. This is the widest barchetta regularly specified, associated with the most expressive and relaxed Italian tailoring traditions — particularly soft, deconstructed Neapolitan jackets in substantial cloths. The extra width means the curvature of the welt sweeps over a broader arc, making it visible even at a distance and serving as the defining design feature of the jacket.

garment.fabric: fine wool suiting with visible weave
